description: This file implements a buffer management system for serialization, including buffer pooling, dynamic resizing, and I/O operations, within the 'buffer' package.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: A buffer optimized for serialization, supporting dynamic resizing, appending data, and output operations.

methods.name: EnsureSpace
methods.description: Ensures the buffer has at least s free bytes, expanding if necessary.

methods.name: AppendByte
methods.description: Appends a single byte to the buffer.

methods.name: AppendBytes
methods.description: Appends a byte slice to the buffer.

methods.name: AppendString
methods.description: Appends a string to the buffer.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Calculates total size of the buffer including all chunks.

methods.name: DumpTo
methods.description: Outputs buffer contents to an io.Writer and resets the buffer.

methods.name: BuildBytes
methods.description: Creates a single byte slice with all buffer contents, optionally reusing a provided slice.

methods.name: ReadCloser
methods.description: Creates an io.ReadCloser with all buffer contents.
